propositions: Plan-review Pass 1 currently collapses failed criteria to empty success and checkpoints without policy/prompt/contract/topology inputs, losing operational context.

Plan-review must migrate to execute discovery topology through the S2 shared typed kernel while preserving YAML graph, facet packing, model ladder, bounded concurrency, cache warming, and cancellation behavior.

The new checkpoint key must change when any material, code/ref, policy, prompt, contract, model/mode, topology, context, dependency, or namespace input changes; legacy and corrupt entries produce zero reuse.
Failed, cancelled, skipped, or budget-shed work must remain missing and callable on later runs; only content-identical success/resume envelopes seed checkpoint reuse.

The final BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/PASS verdict must apply the approved failure policy: preserve successful findings, skip dependents of missing work, and return INDETERMINATE only if no real blocking finding wins.
The reducer-ignored review journal persists versioned safe trace while review-plan and review-plan --status outputs retain only their established end-result fields.
